data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish name ‘Sancho’, which is a contracted form of ‘Sancho Panza’. The name ‘Sancho’ is a combination of ‘San’ (Saint) and ‘cho’ (servant). In the literary context, Sancho is most famously known as the loyal and faithful squire to Don Quixote.
